results.title: Workday Wednesday Meetings
results.content: The project will modernize outdated pay practices, improve payroll-related business processes, and enhance services delivered through the Workday payroll system for the state of Oregon. *   Workday Drive > Payroll Resources > Reports > PAY YTD Overtime Report *   There will be a Workday Announcement posted for all employees on Jan. 8, 2026, to inform them on the new overtime report available in Benefits and Pay hub. No Retro Date was changed to Dec. 1, 2025, after December Run 1 payroll processing *   For those who can't attend, please make sure your teams (HR, Payroll, Budget, etc.) know where to find the Workday Wednesday meeting notes: https://www.oregon.gov/das/hr/pages/workday-wednesday.aspx Your agencies primary contact, known as Agency Readiness Contact, can also be found here. *   **No Retro Date will be changed to Dec. 1, 2025,** after December Run 1 payroll processing The State Tax Visual resource will be distributed via E-News and on Workday Drive for Payroll Partners to share with their agency employees.
